snippet.title: The Deepest Castle - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for The Deepest Castle, a retro dungeon crawler hack-and-slash action-adventure game developed by Serge Bobrov. Players will take up swords as mighty knights to dispatch a fortress full of evil and magic. Explore the dungeon, find precious artifacts, and attain rare weapons from run to run. The Deepest Castle is coming soon to PC (Steam).
